content: He who has a thousand friends has not a friend to spare, and he who has one enemy will meet him everywhere.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Cultivating animosity poisons our peace of mind, making the whole world feel hostile. Forgiveness and harmony restore a friendly universe.
practicalInsight: Release a lingering resentment today; harboring an enemy costs too much internal peace.
reflectionPrompt: Whom do you need to forgive so you no longer meet them in your restless thoughts?
